name: FND_HTTP_TICKETS
description: Table to store short-lifespan and one-time-use tickets

columns.name: TICKET
columns.description: Random 128-bit binary value assigned as the ticket for the secured operation - this is the primary key for the table.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date the ticket was issued, default SYSDATE

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date the ticket will expire; null indicates that the ticket has no pre-set expiration.

columns.name: OPERATION
columns.description: An optional place to store the operation or function associated with the ticket.This is to provide extra security versus operations that are passed through the client without any other validity checks.

columns.name: ARGUMENT
columns.description: An optional place to store arguments to the operation, again as an extra security measure.
